name: RC-B10-0451/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of all political prisoners in Belarus and says it does not recognise Aliaksandr Lukashenka as the country's president. It asks the European Union to keep supporting Belarusian democrats, independent media and people who fled abroad, and to tighten sanctions on the regime. It also urges the European Union to hold those responsible for repression to account. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing directly; it is a set of demands to the European Union and its member states.
- **Who it affects:** Belarus's government, political prisoners, exiles, journalists and European Union governments.
- **What happens next:** The demands go to European Union institutions and member states, which decide whether to act.
